fixed_population.source: Q019 fixed Treasury 10-Year auction result events

historical_release_semantics.inference: The fixed Q019 result information was available on auction_date, while record_date is a later date anchor; exact historical intraday release timestamps are not required to establish this date-level separation.

conclusion: Q025 validates the date-level PIT distinction needed for H2: Q019 record_date is later than the auction date for all 89 events, and the official result-PDF identity is complete. This permits a fixed H2 timing variant using the next XNYS session after auction_date without treating Q025 as performance evidence.
next_step: Separate H2 performance preregistration on a new symbol-disjoint universe with the signal mapping shifted from Q019 record_date to auction_date, mapped to the first XNYS session strictly after auction_date.
